ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def circle_mask(shape, cx, cy, r):
    y,x=np.indices(shape)
    return (x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2 < r*r


def clean_floor(hi):

    y,x=np.indices((h,w))
    # The initial and final views give complementary observations of the floor.
    early_mask=circle_mask((h,w),503,461,75)

    use=early_mask & ~late_mask

    # the surrounding observed floor and correct its low-frequency illumination.
